reviewStatus: Agent-authored before implementation; human independent review pending.
scope: Independent streaming workload; not a blind or human-adjudicated benchmark.

requirements.text: Stream at least 50000 valid logical records without retaining emitted events; preserve aggregate identifiers, amounts, activity and note content.
Results must be independent of source read chunk sizes, including one-character reads across escaped quotes and multiline fields.
Mixed invalid records must produce three ordered conversion issues and must not discard following valid records.
Requesting the first event from a million-record source must not consume the whole source; early disposal leaves the caller's reader open.
Cancelling after accepted records must terminate with an explicit cancellation outcome, without accepting another data record.
Exactly the configured number of data records may be emitted; the next record is a RowLimit terminal outcome.
Comma-delimited input with quoted German numeric amounts preserves decimal values independently of read boundaries.
On valid generated inputs, direct CsvHelper mapping and the functional adapter must produce equal complete output digests before timings are reported.
Record warmed repeated elapsed time and process-wide managed allocation deltas, runtime, fixture inputs, source/artifact hashes and raw samples. No CI performance threshold or superiority claim.
